q: 1. The minimum and maximum number of members in the user's committee should be ........
explain: As per the answer key, a user's committee has a minimum of 9 and a maximum of 15 members.

q: 2. In any project, Public Work Directives (PWD) accept the following guideline
options: present and past regulation of GoN
explain: Public Work Directives are designed to accommodate donor guidelines, government regulations (past and present), and changes in national law, making it a comprehensive guiding document.

q: 3. The award of contract is given to those bidders whose
explain: Contracts are typically awarded to the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder, i.e., the bidder with the lowest bid amount.

q: 4. Who is the Chairperson of Construction Material Rate Fixation Committee?
explain: The Chief District Officer (CDO) chairs the Construction Material Rate Fixation Committee at the district level.

q: 5. The contract will be awarded to ........
explain: Under public procurement rules, the contract goes to the bidder who is both substantially responsive and has the lowest evaluated bid.

q: 6. The authority to conduct the technical auditing in Nepal lies with ........
options: Office of Prime Minister and Council Of Ministers
explain: As per the answer key, the National Vigilance Center is the answer.

q: 7. According to Public Work Directives (PWD), applicable rate for the liquidity damage is
explain: PWD prescribes liquidated damages for delay at a rate of 0.1% to 0.5% of the contract price per day of delay, subject to a maximum cap.

q: 8. Force majeure in a contract is of ........
options: occurrence of an act beyond the control of both contracting parties
preventing both parties to perform the respective obligation agreed
explain: Force majeure is an event beyond the control of both parties that prevents them from performing their obligations, so both statements apply.

q: 9. The user's committee method may be used for labour intensive works with a cost estimate of
explain: The user's committee procurement method is applicable for labour-intensive works with an estimated cost up to NRs 2.5 million.

q: 10. Generally during the evaluation of consulting firms to award the contract, the weightage will be ........
explain: Consultants are usually evaluated on quality and cost, with the technical score weighted much higher (80:20). Option d has a misprint (800%) in the book.

q: 11. Direct purchase can be done when the amount is
explain: Direct purchase (procurement without competitive bidding) is permitted under Public Procurement rules when the estimated amount is less than NRs 0.15 million.

q: 12. Who is the chairperson of Project Coordination Committee?
explain: The Project Coordination Committee at the district level is chaired by the Chairperson of the District Development Committee (DDC).

q: 13. The type of contract when payment shall be made for actual work done at site is ........
explain: In a unit rate contract, payment is made on the measured quantities of work actually done at the agreed unit rates.

q: 14. In Nepal, Public Procurement Act (PPA), was established in
explain: The Public Procurement Act (PPA) of Nepal was enacted in 2063 B.S.

q: 15. The penalty provision on any contract agreement is ........
explain: As per the answer key, the delay penalty (liquidated damage) is 0.05% of the contract price per day.

q: 16. The maximum amount of advance payment (mobilization fund) permitted is ........ of contract.
explain: As per the answer key, the maximum mobilization advance is 20% of the contract amount.

q: 17. The term EPC stands for ........
explain: EPC means Engineering, Procurement and Construction, a turnkey contract where one contractor does all three.

q: 18. The price adjustment clause is essential for contract having duration greater than ........ months.
explain: As per the answer key, the clause is essential for contracts longer than 12 months.

q: 19. For the procurements of works upto 20 million by which method of procurement is ........
options: by direct labor or direct negotiation
explain: As per the answer key, works up to the threshold are procured by sealed quotation.

q: 20. The department head can extend the time up to ........ more than initial contract duration.
explain: As per the answer key, the department head can extend the time up to 25% of the initial duration.

q: 21. The contract adopted if all the items are easily measurable is ........
explain: When all items can be measured easily, an item rate contract is used and payment follows measured quantities.

q: 22. Consulting work worth more than 3 crores should be procured on the basis of ........
explain: As per the answer key, high-value consulting work is procured through international-level EOI followed by RFP.

q: 23. Performance security deposit for the contractor is equal to ........
explain: Performance security is 5% of the contract amount, per the answer key.

q: 24. The authority to conduct the monitoring of public procurement in Nepal lies in ........
explain: The Public Procurement Monitoring Office (PPMO) monitors public procurement.

q: 25. The abbreviation PWD stands for
explain: In the standard procurement framework context of Nepal, PWD stands for Public Works Directives.

q: 26. Prequilification is not required for any types of firm if the costing to buy an equipment is
explain: Prequalification procedures are exempt for procurement works/goods below 20 million NRs thresholds.

q: 27. The opening of bidding in the process of procurement is known as ........
explain: Inviting and opening bids in procurement is called tendering.

q: 28. The minimum and maximum no. of members in the user's committee should be
explain: According to Nepal Public Procurement Regulations (PPR), a User Committee must consist of a minimum of 9 and maximum of 15 members.

q: 29. प्रत्येक बोलपत्र दाताले बढीमा कतिवटा बोलपत्र दाखिला गर्न सक्छ ?
explain: Under PPR provisions, a bidder can submit only one bid for the same procurement package.

q: 30. The maximum and minimum number of members in the user's committee should be
explain: As per Public Procurement rules, a user's committee should have a maximum of 15 and a minimum of 9 members.

q: 31. In case of National Competitive Bidding, the prices shall be quoted in
explain: National Competitive Bidding (NCB) rules mandate that financial quotes and transactions must strictly be in Nepalese Rupees (NRs).

q: 32. The employer's have right to ........
explain: The employer may accept or reject bids, within the procurement rules.

q: 33. The number of members in dispute resolution committee are
explain: A standard Dispute Resolution Board (DRB / Adjudication) usually consists of 1 or 3 neutral members.

q: 34. Who is the chairperson of construction material rate fixation committee?
explain: The Chief District Officer chairs the district rate fixation committee.

q: 35. For the supply of any goods as per agreement, who is responsible for the all taxed imposed by the GON ........
explain: The supplier bears all taxes imposed by the Government of Nepal under a supply agreement.

q: 36. Who is the chairperson of project co ordination committee?
explain: As per the answer key, the chairperson of the DDC chairs the project coordination committee.

q: 37. Time extension may need to be granted due to
options: both a) and b) of above
explain: Contractual time extensions are legally justified by employer/purchaser delays or uncontrollable force majeure events.

q: 38. What is the abbreviation used for German Technical Co-operation?
explain: GTZ (Deutsche Gesellschaft für Technische Zusammenarbeit) was the historical abbreviation for German Technical Cooperation (now GIZ).

q: 39. The duration of notice for sealed quotation is ........ days.
explain: As per the answer key, the sealed quotation notice period is 15 days.

q: 40. Which action does not fall under the principle of public procurement
options: procurement should be economic and efficient
procurement should be always be lowest cost
information and equal opportunities to all
explain: Public procurement focuses on 'lowest evaluated substantially responsive bid' rather than blindly picking lowest cost regardless of technical quality.

q: 41. The duration of notice for national competitive bidding in days ........
explain: National competitive bidding requires a 30-day notice period.

q: 42. The variation exceeding 15% of the contract amount is approved by
explain: Variations beyond 15% historically require Cabinet/Council of Ministers or higher departmental authority approval specified by law.

q: 43. The duration of notice for international competitive bidding in days ........
explain: International bidders need more time, so the notice period is 45 days.

q: 44. There is no fixation of qualification of contractor for execution of work up to ........
explain: As per the answer key, no contractor qualification is fixed for small works up to 20 million.

q: 45. Who is the Chairperson of Project Co-ordination Committee?
explain: At the district decentralization level, the Chairperson of the District Development Committee (DDC) chairs project coordination meetings.

q: 46. Language of PQ document or notice of international bidding is ........
explain: International bidding documents and notices are issued in English so that foreign bidders can participate.

q: 47. Who is the Chairperson of Construction Material Rate fixation Committee?
explain: The Chief District Officer (CDO) heads the district-level Rate Fixation Committee for construction materials and labor.

q: 48. The contractor or consultant are liable to black listing if they are unable to perform as per contract up to ........ years.
explain: Blacklisting for non-performance runs for a period of 1 to 3 years.

q: 49. Who is the Chairperson of House Rent Fixation Committee ?
explain: Government office house rent valuation and fixation committees are headed by the Chief District Officer (CDO).

q: 50. The bid security shall be forfeited if
options: Bidder withdraws its bid during the period of bid validity specified by the bidder on the Bid form
in case of successful bidder, if the bidder fails within the specified time limit either sign the contract or furnish performance security
explain: Bid security guarantees bid commitment; premature withdrawal or failure to execute contract/performance guarantee leads to forfeiture.
